data.body:
Final implementation report for avoided-flannel-eeve.

Problem: MCP write path timed out on a stale `op=compact-sweep` write-lock owner stamp while the kernel `.ticket-write.lock` was free.

Proven root cause: MCP `log_session` reaches shared `lock.write_lock`; `_acquire_once` obtains fcntl then polls `.ticket-write.lock.d`, and timeout diagnostics render `.ticket-write.lock.d/owner`. `_stamp_is_stale` treated a same-host/same-namespace live pid with unknown start time as fresh until the 1h ceiling, and `_describe_stamped_pid` rendered bare `_pid_alive` as `live`. On no-`/proc`/pid-reuse this is not proof of ownership.

Proof: forged an isolated same-host compact-sweep stamp for pid 49003; proved fcntl was free by taking `LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB`; drove real FastMCP `log_session`; trace showed fcntl acquired, `_pid_alive=True`, `_process_start_time=None`, then timeout with `pid_state=live`. After the fix the same reproduction succeeds in 0.43s, reclaims the mkdir dir, and records the log.

Defect origin: `larval-tribal-tigermoth` / `ab00-1407-2da3-42fd`, by plan-defect/omission. That fix explicitly deferred immediate reclaim from the held fcntl leg; this incident proves MCP/write budgets need it. `caused_by` edge is recorded and close will pass `--caused-by=larval-tribal-tigermoth`.

RED→GREEN test: `tests/interfaces/store/test_mcp_write_lock_dead_stamp.py` was RED first with `ToolError` / `flock: could not acquire lock after 1s ... pid_state=live`; GREEN after fix. Unit coverage added in `tests/unit/test_lock_age_ceiling.py` and `tests/unit/test_lock_timeout_names_holder_7084.py`; staging advisory coverage added in `tests/interfaces/store/test_atomic_ticket_dir_create_021d.py`. Sandboxed mutation restored the old ceiling-only branch and returned the held-out MCP test to RED; restoring the fix made it GREEN again.

Fix: in `src/rebar/_store/lock_owner.py`, a same-host v2 stamp whose pid is a different process is stale immediately when the waiter holds fcntl; without fcntl proof it still waits for the ceiling. Diagnostics now report unverified/recycled pid states unless start time corroborates ownership. `src/rebar/_store/staging.py` treats `not-owner` as abandonment proof.

Scope/safety: caller sweep found all write surfaces route through shared `lock.write_lock`/`lock.acquire`; no behavioral dependency on the stale timeout found. The fix restores existing lock progress, adds no dependency, and weakens no tests.

Step-7 sweep/parity: construct sweep found one staleness authority (`_stamp_is_stale`) and no duplicate pid-probe lock implementation. CLI, MCP/API, library facade, sync/push/fsck/compact/inbound automated callers all share the fixed core. Diagnostics consumers (`doctor_locks`, `enrich_drain`) are covered. Reconciler `_ref_lock.py`/`_heartbeat.py` are N/A: they use git-ref oid/fence lease progress, not pid stamps. Stamped-file locks share the diagnostic/staleness table but have no fcntl leg, so they retain the ceiling.

Validation: `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_lock_age_ceiling.py tests/unit/test_lock_timeout_names_holder_7084.py tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor_locks.py tests/interfaces/store/test_atomic_ticket_dir_create_021d.py tests/interfaces/store/test_mcp_write_lock_dead_stamp.py -q` => 106 passed. `make lint` passed. `make typecheck` passed. Commit trailer verified.

Gerrit: change 2474 patch set 2 got LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 (GitHub Actions run 33474884292), then submitted as `a76c7dbd38200a385ad441aafe040bc8eabbee51`. Origin/main now contains that commit. Residual risk/prevention: deployed MCP server was proven to use a different tracker path/clone than the local CLI; accepted as environment evidence for this bug and fixed at the shared code path so the private clone recovers after deploy/restart. No additional sibling tickets filed to avoid duplicate board flood.
